invariants: Observation, normalization, interpretation and cross-script claims remain distinct.
Unknown values are never imputed solely to satisfy comparison or schema completeness.
Cross-corpus metrics require compatible definitions and provenance.
Cross-script relationships are explicit non-transitive claims, never shared native identifiers.
Rights and redistribution constraints survive exports.
Blocked and negative outcomes are publishable results.
Family releases check all member repositories for compatibility; version numbers need not match.
next_family_gate: Source-compatible measured definitions plus a legitimate frozen linguistic known-answer control; software fixtures do not satisfy it.
next_action: Expand object metadata, concordances and verified occurrences with exact provenance.
membership_boundary: Native evidence only; membership implies no linguistic affinity, shared sign identities, or pooled analysis.
